snippet.title: Pico's School: Love Conquers All - [Full Walkthrough]
snippet.description:
This is the Love Conquers All edition of Pico's School; a re-telling of the original story in a split reality where one small decision changes the course of events. This game replaced the original Pico's School on April 1st, 2021 but now they both exist together as alternate timelines.

Game by: TomFulp
Play the game: https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/787272
